NEW src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts. Define pure dispatch work keys and acceptance receipts plus lease fencing and crash rules. Tests: src/domain/durable-dispatch.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Dispatch recovery can complete the wrong operation — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts:124-127,167-185,239-255
  EXPECTED: Distinct accepted work keys cannot complete from the same branch-level pull request without evidence linking it to the operation.
  ACTUAL: Task sets [T001] and [T002] both return create_new with branch feat/049-example-phase-01. Recovery returns complete_from_pr for the second operation when given the first operation's pull request.
  FIX: Preserve the work key scope in branch and recovery identity, or serialize shared branch use and require an operation-specific link before completing from a pull request. Cover distinct task sets and stale recovery in the phase gate.

NEW src/domain/durable-harvest.ts. Define pure harvest work keys and PR verification plus stage plans and tip checks. Tests: src/domain/durable-harvest.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Harvest accepts invalid pull request identity — FR-002.
  WHERE: src/domain/durable-harvest.ts:162-214
  EXPECTED: Verify a positive integer pull request number and check any supplied URL against the enrolled repository and pull request number before deriving the work key.
  ACTUAL: verifyHarvestTarget returns ok: true with prNumber: 0 and prUrl: https://github.com/acme/other/pull/42 for enrolled repository acme/repo.
  FIX: Reject invalid numbers and conflicting supplied pull request identities. Add both cases to the phase gate.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Branch cleanup does not verify the head repository — FR-005.
  WHERE: src/domain/durable-harvest.ts:64-79,295-335
  EXPECTED: Permit deletion only if the pull request head repository is known and matches the enrolled repository, and the branch tip matches the expected SHA.
  ACTUAL: evaluateBranchCleanupSafety compares only projectRepoSlug and candidateRepoSlug. A fork pull request targeting the enrolled repository is indistinguishable from a same-repository pull request when branch and SHA match. The policy returns delete_at_tip for both.
  FIX: Carry the head repository separately through the GitHub fact, harvest candidate and cleanup inputs. Block deletion for unknown or mismatched head repositories. Add a matching-name and matching-tip fork regression to the phase gate.

NEW src/ports/operations-port.ts. Declare `ClockPort` and `OperationsStorePort` plus `GitHubHarvestPort`, `WorkerExecutionPort` and `HarvestExecutionPort`

REVIEW FAIL (code): Recovery port cannot enumerate persisted harvests or outbound sends — FR-003 and FR-004.
  WHERE: src/ports/operations-port.ts:272-333
  EXPECTED: The injected store exposes eligible incomplete harvests and pending or uncertain outbox items to startup and replay.
  ACTUAL: claimHarvestLease and claimOutboxItem require IDs. The port has no harvest recovery scan and no outbox read that returns item IDs. getOperationsStatus exposes stage summaries and outbox counts. A crash after intake or enqueue loses the in-memory ID needed to claim that work.
  FIX: Add store queries for recoverable harvest operations and project-scoped outbox work. Include unstarted harvests and recoverable sending or uncertain items. Exercise recovery through the port with only durable state available.

Add the same field to `HarvestPullRequestFact` and `DurableHarvestOperation` in `src/ports/operations-port.ts`. Populate it from GitHub’s head repository and persist it through intake and replay. Keep unknown values `null`. Return `block_cleanup` with `HEAD_REPO_MISMATCH` unless the head repository matches enrollment. Keep the expected SHA check before returning `delete_at_tip`.
FIX: specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-01.sh — Use the existing `src/domain/durable-harvest.test.ts` gate entry to reject zero and fractional pull request numbers. Independently test malformed URLs, a different repository and a different pull request number. With matching branch names and tips, assert that fork and unknown heads block deletion and that an enrolled-repository head permits it.
FIX: src/ports/operations-port.ts — Add `listRecoverableHarvests(input: { nowIso: string; projectId?: string }): DurableHarvestOperation[]` and `listRecoverableOutboxItems(input: { nowIso: string; projectId: string }): OutboxItem[]` to `OperationsStorePort`. Return unstarted `accepted` harvests even without stage receipts and resumable harvests without a live lease. Return project-scoped `pending`, `uncertain` and abandoned `sending` items in creation order. Keep claims atomic and route recovered `sending` and `uncertain` items to `reconcile`.
FIX: specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-01.sh — Add `src/ports/operations-port.test.ts` to the Vitest command. Use an injected `OperationsStorePort` fixture rebuilt from persisted rows alone. Discover and claim an unstarted harvest and a pending send without retaining their intake IDs. Assert `reconcile` for abandoned `sending` and `uncertain` items. Exclude live leases, terminal rows and outbox rows from other projects. Add both query names to the existing interface check in `src/architecture.test.ts`.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Lease fence can accept a claim from another operation — FR-003.
  WHERE: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts:221-245
  EXPECTED: Require current.operationId and return LEASE_FENCED when it differs from candidate.operationId, even if owner and epoch match.
  ACTUAL: current.operationId?: string makes the comparison conditional. A lease projection from operation B with owner worker-a and epoch 1 returned { ok: true } for operation A's fence when the projection omitted its ID.
  FIX: Require operation identity on the current lease and compare it unconditionally. Add a gate case with two operations sharing the same owner and epoch.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Worker launch drops the accepted task scope — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/ports/operations-port.ts:80-94
  EXPECTED: WorkerExecutionPort.launchPhaseShip receives the persisted task IDs so recovery can execute the accepted scope. An empty list represents phase-wide work.
  ACTUAL: The launch input has projectRoot, trunkBranch, branchName, featureId, phaseId and backend. It has no taskIds. The operation-specific branch contains a one-way hash of the work identity.
  FIX: Add taskIds to the launch input or pass the durable request. Exercise two distinct task-scoped requests for the same phase through an injected worker port after restart.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Outbox claim cannot persist the resolved destination before send — FR-004.
  WHERE: src/ports/operations-port.ts:184-209,323-351
  EXPECTED: Persist the actual workspace, channel and thread with the client metadata key before sending so replay can reconcile the same destination.
  ACTUAL: OutboxMessage has only the accepted recipient hint. claimOutboxItem accepts only outboxId and nowIso. markOutboxUncertain accepts only claim, nowIso and error. The destination may differ from the hint after feature thread lookup. The first explicit channel and thread write is the delivered outcome after the send.
  FIX: Add a fenced pre-send destination write or persist the resolved destination during the atomic send claim. Reuse it on reconciliation. Add a restart case where the feature thread changes after a send and before a delivery receipt commits.

  WHERE: src/domain/durable-dispatch.ts:247-285; src/domain/durable-dispatch.test.ts:282-308
  EXPECTED: Requeue a stopped worker only after GitHub evidence rules out an open or merged pull request for the operation. Hold recovery when a candidate pull request has unresolved ownership.
